snippet.title: Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence - Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description: DevilishGames and Making Enemies are excited to announce that Scholar Adventure: Mystery of Silence will be released on Steam on December 9 for $7.99, with a 10% launch discount. Add it to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929410/Scholar_Adventure_Mystery_of_Silence/
